import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
p=pathlib.Path('eval-log/system-spec-harness/audit-fork-ledger.jsonl')
for l in p.read_text().splitlines():
  d=json.loads(l); print(d.get('record_kind'),d.get('subagent_type'),d.get('tool_use_id'),d.get('session_id'),d.get('response_sha256'),d.get('audit_verdict'))
R=str(pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'plugins/system-spec-harness/scripts/build-audit-verification.py','--state',R+'/system-spec/spec-state.json','--references',R+'/system-spec/fetched-references.json','--repo-root',R,'--expected-sha256','20ed2084039553161edcf0ca3aba61c0e2b5205fe2aeed311c707b7f11300d6a'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print('reverify exit',r.returncode, json.loads(r.stdout).get('verification_sha256') if r.stdout.strip().startswith('{') else r.stdout[:300], r.stderr[:300])
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'plugins/system-spec-harness/scripts/validate-hearing-sources.py','--matrix',R+'/system-spec/spec-state.json','--repo-root',R],capture_output=True,text=True)
print('hearing src exit',r.returncode, json.loads(r.stdout)==json.loads('''{\"errors\": [], \"ok\": true, \"repo_root\": \"'''+R+'''\", \"schema_version\": \"1.0\", \"scope\": \"written-source-path-and-digest\", \"sources\": [], \"state_path\": \"'''+R+'''/system-spec/spec-state.json\", \"state_sha256\": \"9c14364c152783c1decc09072eada93cdfc78f0fef15d83d2874a028b718e6c2\"}'''))
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts/build-resume-receipt.py','--repo-root',R,'--print-artifact-snapshot'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print('snapshot sha', __import__('hashlib').sha256(r.stdout.encode()).hexdigest())
"
